name: Minecraft Modpack (CurseForge)
description: Minecraft server installed from a pinned CurseForge modpack file.

agreement.title: Minecraft EULA
agreement.text: You must accept the Minecraft End User License Agreement before creating this server.

composeInline:
services:
  minecraft:
    image: itzg/minecraft-server:java21
    container_name: vestri-{{SERVER_SLUG}}
    ports:
      - "25565:25565"
    environment:
      EULA: "TRUE"
      MODPACK_PLATFORM: "AUTO_CURSEFORGE"
      CF_PAGE_URL: "{{CURSEFORGE_URL}}"
      MEMORY: "4G"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
    stdin_open: true
    tty: true
    restart: unless-stopped
